ObservedBehavior: Grid coordinates are one-based
ControlBlockSize is 3; edge blocks may be partial
Runtime applies pollution to the entire block; legacy test conflicts
Owned and unpolluted cell controls its block
Standard cell must be owned, unpolluted, and empty
Cost and per-unit cooldown gate deployment
Initial values clamp; non-positive gain is ignored
Fixed and transmitter timers produce independently
Non-positive spend is a successful no-op
Deploy list maximum is 12
First requirement 7; next same-stage requirement 14
Candidate counts are 4/3/2 by stage
No controlled unpolluted block means defeat
No valid spawn can mean defeat when building objective is disabled
Zero enemy buildings means victory when enabled
RequiredAssaultScore exists but does not currently decide victory
Allies advance forward; enemies advance backward; adjacent-block arrival selects the battle block and reserved faction rows; survivors resume movement
Moving melee in one control block can attack across small-cell columns; actors in different control-block columns do not engage
Attack progress resets without a target; completed intervals accumulate and a large tick may attack multiple times
Pending attacks resolve together; U01 and E01 can kill each other simultaneously; death is emitted once
Melee reserves battle rows, selects the encounter block by first arrival, supports multiple attackers, and emits battlefield lifecycle events
Enemy moves from high rows toward low owned rows; undefended entry pollutes the full 3x3 block, clears ownership, and kills the invader
A block emits active once when both melee teams occupy it and inactive once after one team is eliminated
Inclusive stage periods and rate denominators drive waves; stages stop after the final period
PerWave caps unique spawn columns and Types are selected by integer weights using a seeded RNG
A column with no owned unpolluted cell is excluded and can reduce wave size
Runtime moves a whole control-block column before its nearest building block and retreats after destruction; old immediate-cell assertions conflict
Application controls wave lifecycle and turns spawn requests into combat actors without putting QFramework in Domain
E06/E07 are stationary enemy buildings with durability and assault-score rewards
Enemy-building death updates building count and spawn points before outcome evaluation
Every enemy death awards its non-negative reward once; required score does not directly override building victory
Outcome priority is lost territory, invalid spawn when building objective disabled, then zero enemy buildings when enabled; terminal state stops spawning
A building occupies all nine cells of its 3x3 control block and can be attacked from all three covered columns
The characterization battlefield is widened from 9x9 to 15x9; columns are visually separated into groups of three and contain three non-overlapping nine-cell buildings
E06 E07 and E12 have no ID-specific ability branch; differences are configuration values only
Every living E13 deals stacking 0.1 HP per second fractional damage to living allies within Manhattan control-block range before movement and attacks
E14 gains 1 HP for every target killed by its applied pending damage without a durability cap; an already-registered killing attack may revive E14 before death reporting

E15 has a 15-second initial delay, then every completed 12-second interval executes the lowest-HP eligible non-building non-stealth opponent in range using deterministic tie-breakers; completed empty cycles are consumed and execution precedes pending damage
L01 expands from 6x10 macro cells to 18x30 small cells; building coordinates map to control-block centers and only Stage1 Stage2 Finale are selected in declared order
